decisions.reason: As a broad training offer tied closely to the installed systems base, it likely meets at least minimum aspiration levels and is cheap to carry while supporting service revenues and customer retention.

This narrower training course is more exposed if demand falls short of aspiration, but with some organisational slack it is still worth keeping as a complement to the airfield lighting business rather than dropping immediately.

The collaboration software fits the firm's strategic move toward integrated and data-driven airport operations, so unless performance is clearly below aspiration management would continue it and learn from the market.

As a flagship surveillance product strongly aligned with the firm's future direction and core engineering capabilities, it would be retained despite uncertainty unless results were markedly below aspiration.
